document: Honour 2nd dose of Pfizer vaccine within 21 - 28 days for recipients of 1st dose, Change decision to extend the length of time between Pfizer vaccine doses. It should be 21 to 28 days which is in line with vaccine manufacturers evidence based recommendation.

Dont delay 2nd Covid vaccine dose so elderly/NHS have maximum protection sooner., Give the second dose of the vaccine to people within 3 or 4 weeks as recommended by the vaccine manufacturers and MHRA so maximum efficacy is achieved. Speed up the vaccine delivery program significantly by providing more people to vaccinate. e.g. Pharmacists could be used.
Make face masks compulsory for secondary pupils and school staff in classrooms, The WHO make it clear that face coverings should be worn where social distancing of 2 metres cannot be ensured.

Government need to deliver second dose of Pfizer Covid vaccine at 21 days., Delivery of the Pfizer vaccine has been approved for use in the UK. With very limited research available regarding safety we have placed our trust in the Government by consenting to have this vaccine to essentially preserve life and save our NHS. We strongly oppose the delay in second dose delivery.

Ban vaccines being administered in a manner not fully tested in clinical trials, Following advice by the JCVI and Chief Medical Officers the NHS is increasing the interval between the first and second doses of Covid-19 vaccines, and in exceptional circumstances being permitted to substitute one vaccine for the other for second doses.
Primary schools closed area Berkshire and Bucks area due high risk Covid, This area high risk COVID-19 primary

All pupils to repeat this current academic year., All pupils have had inconsistent education since March 2020.  During the autumn term, some pupils were forced to isolate, some schools closed & now there is a delay to the spring term. If they all repeated the year from Sept 2021, they would be in a much better position for future learning.
Continue to vaccinate as per the original Covid 19 vaccination agreement, Stop the push to vaccinate once, and delay the second dose for Covid 19.  Not allow mixing of vaccines for Covid 19

Prioritise special school staff in Covid 19 vaccinations., The unique requirements of working with children with additional needs means that social distancing and effective use of PPE is virtually impossible. Vaccinating special school staff will also offer protection to the children and their families.

Prioritise Healthcare Staff at the top of the list for Covid19 immunisation, A basic principle of control of an infectious disease by immunisation is that staff caring for patients must be protected first even before people at high risk. The CMOs have ignored this advice putting NHS & Care Staff at risk. They should be Top Prority.

Continue to give the second dose of the Pfizer Covid-19 vaccine at 21/28 days., The Pfizer Covid-19 vaccination is 95% effective when a second dose is given at 21 days. There is no evidence for delaying the second dose for 12 weeks, but this is what the government has decided to do. This move has been criticised by the vaccine manufacturers.
Vaccinate teachers and support staff NOW to keep schools OPEN, Prioritise COVID vaccinations for teachers, TA’s and all ancillary support staff to keep schools open.

Abolish fine's for parents for unauthorised absences!, We wish for school fines be abolished until after the COVID-19 pandemic is over or until the vaccination has reached at least 50% of the UK Population. 

If a parent decides they believe schools are not safe enough to risk sending their children to school they should not also have to fear fines.

Include Cabin Crew as frontline staff and prioritise for Covid 19 vaccine, Include Airline Cabin Crew as frontline staff and key workers and give us a higher priority to be vaccinated for the Covid 19 vaccine due to the nature of the job.
Call a General Election as soon as CoVid is behind us., Dissolve the Government to call a General Election based on a wide-array of issues than just the Brexit process.

All teachers to be on priority list to get covid vaccine., Please support me to get as many signatures as possible to help support these teachers as key workers who are also working in upfront, risking their lives for our kids.

Provide routine Covid tests for Early Years and prioritise staff for vaccination, The Early Years Sector has been widely over looked by the government. Routine testing takes places in care homes, hospitals and soon schools. Staff have to work in close contact with children with no PPE. We need protection through Covid screening and priority access to vaccinations.

Make all essential workers a priority for receiving the Covid-19 vaccine sooner, Make essential workers a higher priority for receiving the vaccine. Especially supermarket workers, as they are/always have been putting themselves at risk every day to keep the nation fed!

Give pregnant women unable to work from home rights to be suspended on full pay, I want the Government to give pregnant women who cannot work from home the right to be suspended on full pay. There needs to be new protection for pregnant women put into place immediately. It is vital that pregnant women and their unborn babies are being protected across the country.

Close nurseries to ensure the protection of Early Years Workers., Close all nurseries and early years centres across England at parliament’s earliest opportunity in line with schools and colleges. This can be revised at a stage when the pandemic is under control or enough of the populace have received their 1st vaccine.

Make the COVID-19 vaccine available to all students on placement in the pandemic, Students are being sent out into the community as part of their studies during the pandemic. Making the COVID-19 vaccine available to all students out on placement will reduce the risk to ourselves  family members and to the community. Protect us so we can continue to protect you.

VACCINATION FOR SCHOOL STAFF, Recognise that school staff are at risk just as much as frontline/care staff.
Vaccinate ALL SCHOOL STAFF WORKING IN SCHOOLS WITH THE CHILDREN OF FRONTLINE STAFF DESERVE TO BE TREATED AS FRONTLINE STAFF AND BE VACCINATED AGAINST COVID19

Make Pharmacy staff a priority for covid vaccination, Pharmacies are deemed essential and the staff are often exposed to poorly people. The staff on pharmacy counters should be included amongst the early receivers of the vaccine.

Include Teachers in the 1st round of Corona Virus vaccines, I want the group of people receiving the first Covid19 vaccines to include all school staff - most importantly skeleton staff and all teachers that have to bring 10-20 kids into a classroom each day and monitor playgrounds etc.

Enforce NHS services to follow the Equality act when it comes to mask exemptions, Many who have mask exeptions are finding it difficult to access NHS services whether that be thier local GP or specialist services. This is a breach of the Equality Act sections 112 and 119 and potentially the Disabilty Discrimination act also.

Stop Whitehaven Coal Mine in Cumbria, The UK have approved the first deep coal mine in 30 years. The effects of a coal mine will create a major setback in the British climate change efforts. The Government should revoke permission to mine on British soil.

Limit of 25% of attendance to prioritise safety of staff and pupils in education, Limit the number of children attending educational establishments to 25% during the 'lockdown'  to facilitate safety for staff and pupils and break 'transmission' routes to the community. Prioritise keyworker  children and the vulnerable without enabling 'access for all'

Prioritise telecoms and utilities engineers for the vaccination, As a engineer I can go into up-to 10 different houses every day to fix there services that is over upto 40 chances of catching COVID and potentially passing it on to people as I might not know I have it and might just be a carrier

Make addressing Vitamin D Deficiency a UK Public Health Priority, Vitamin D deficiency is known to be a major health problem linked to infectious diseases, such as Covid-19, as well as other serious and chronic diseases. Yet in Winter 40% of the UK population is deficient in Vitamin D rising to near 80% in some BAME groups.

Create a scheme to legally recognise those exempt from wearing face masks, The UK Government should create a scheme to legally recognise those exempt from face masks with official proof of exemption. Currently it’s difficult to enforce the face mask law without proof of exemption.
Both COVID Vaccines within 21-28 days for NHS and Social care workers., Fully protect Front facing NHS and social care staff from COVID 19.

2nd Pfizer Vaccine should be 21Days NOT 12 Weeks: Challenge NHS/Government!, WE WANT NHS ENGLAND TO REVOKE THE DECISION TO DELAY VACCINATING FRONTLINE WORKERS.WE WANT 94% PROTECTION NOT HALF DOSE. GOVERNMENT ARE LETTING DOWN ALL THOSE WHO PUT THEIR LIVES ON THE LINE (AND THOSE WHO DIED).DO THE RIGHT THING PUT BACK THE CORRECT DOSING REGIME AS PER PFIZER DATA.

Include Covid 19 Testers in the frontline worker priority group for vaccination, Include Covid 19 testers in the frontline priority group for vaccination in line with other NHS workers, in order to protect the lives of those most at risk of exposure to the disease. Omission of testing staff means they now wait until over-50s have been vaccinated, which is likely to take months.

Recognise COVID-19 testers as a priority to be vaccinated, To recognise the COVID-19 testers as front line workers who deal with suspected covid patients daily and provide them with the vaccine as a priority just as you do with nurses and Drs and other health care professionals.

Implement teaching of eating disorders into science curriculum for key stage 3+, I am so passionate about the fact there is no where near enough information provided to children in schools about eating disorders. Even the term is so vague because there are so many forms. The disordered thinking, like body dysmorphia, is often a thing many are unaware of and this needs to change.
Fund a vaccination programme for wild rabbits against Myxomatosis, It is not acceptable that such a disease is left unchecked in the wild. Myxomatosis can cause huge suffering to infected rabbits.

Prioritise immediate family of healthcare workers for Covid-19 vaccinate, We think it is imperative that immediate family living with healthcare workers, such as Doctors and Nurses, should be given priority for the Covid-19 vaccine, to ensure that they are protected from the virus.

Give COVID-19 vaccines 24 hours a day to the most at risk and frontline workers, After the Coronavirus Briefing today (11/01/21) when the question was asked if the vaccine could be given 24/7, Matt Hancock said if both the person doing the vaccine and the person receiving the vaccine would prefer for it to be offered 24 hours a day then then they’ll consider it

NHS/care staff to be given priority COVID vaccine; 2 doses at 21/28 day interval, Prioritise NHS/Care staff for the COVID vaccination in line with the license - 2 doses at no longer than licensed interval.

Give breastfeeding mothers to a right to defer/be excused from jury duty, Studies show that new babies need to be close to their mothers. Especially during those early months/years. They rely on their mothers to provide safety, care and nutrition. Breastfeeding mothers should not be expected to stop or leave their babies for jury duty.
Make COVID vaccination available 24 hours a day, I would like COVID vaccinations to be available round the clock. At the moment they are only offered for limited hours.

All pharmacies should be used as part of the Covid-19 vaccine programme., All pharmacies should be used as part of the vaccine programme as they are trusted, have the expertise and are local to every community. JPIMedia's 'Shot In The Arm' campaign calls for everyone to have the ability to get a jab within 10 minutes of their home by using our great pharmacy network.

NHS staff to receive 2nd vaccine on time, I want the government to prioritise health staff and NHS workers to receive both vaccines on time. We have been denied pay rises and staff have out their lives at risk to help others. We are never recognised in what we do and you are going against Pfizer’s advice. Staff have died.

Begin a round-the-clock COVID-19 vaccination programme, If there are available doses, a straightforward booking system and sufficient and capable individuals able to administer such vaccines, to begin as soon as possible a 24 hour, 7 days per week COVID-19 vaccination programme.

Do not rollout Covid-19 vaccine passports, We want the Government to commit to not rolling out any e-vaccination status/immunity passport to the British public. Such passports could be used to restrict the rights of people who have refused a Covid-19 vaccine, which would be unacceptable.

Teach about Mental Health in Schools, My aim is to get primary schools to teach about the different variety of mental Health conditions including OCD, Bipolar, PTSD, Tourettes and Schizophrenia and the many other mental illness subtypes

Include all Supermarkets workers into  priority list to get the Covid-19 Vaccine, What I want it and definitely  the most of my colleagues wants is to get the Covid-19 vaccine in the same priority as NHS workers.

Provide funding for research on the safety of adjuvants in vaccines, Approve funding specifically for vaccine safety. A good area specifically would be the research on adjuvants travelling in the body, their ability to cross the blood-brain barrier (potentially resulting in adverse consequences) and long-term effects of exposure of numerous vaccines and boosters.

Fund widespread Covid-19 T cell testing, including for those offered vaccination, The Government should fund a programme of Covid-19 T cell testing, to establish the extent of pre-existing immune system protection against Covid-19. These should be offered to all recipients of Covid-19 vaccines, as if they have Covid-19 T cells they may not need or want to be vaccinated.

Exempt people on the autistic spectrum or with ADHD from NHS prescription charge, Currently those diagnosed with lifelong conditions such as ADHD and those on the autistic spectrum have to pay for prescriptions. These medications are often not a choice, but a necessity. Please consider adding them to the existing medically exempt groups of illness and conditions.

Prevent digital vaccination passports from being implemented., With vaccination against COVID-19 being well under way in the UK, the question of “digital vaccination passports” has arisen. This petition requests that parliament prevent digital vaccination passports being mandated for the access of mass gatherings, travel, hospitality, etc,
Extend the expiry date on UK passports due to Coronavirus lockdown, We'd like a year added onto the expiry of UK passports.

Provide the vaccine to nursery workers and teachers as a matter of urgency., I would like the government to provide the vaccine for covid 19 to teachers and nursery workers. These are key workers and have kept the country’s education going all the way through the pandemic. These people deserve the vaccine as aster of urgency alongside nurses and healthcare professionals.

Give all health and social care staff their second covid vaccine urgently, Prioritise health and social care workers to get their second dose of the vaccine as promised. Protect the workforce urgently.
Pay 15% bonus to public facing NHS staff, The covid pandemic has required NHS public facing staff to put themselves in harms way to treat and care for covid patients. and their families.

Prioritise keyworkers (supermarket staff) for the covid vaccine., Keyworkers (supermarket staff) are customer facing and at risk every single time they go to work. We can be in close proximity to hundreds if not thousands of people per day and therefore should be prioritised alongside careworkers for receiving the covid vaccine.

Stop Medical Discrimination & Forced Treatment, As above.

Following the Nuremberg Code

Urgent - Vaccinate Teachers and Get Children Back to School, I am a self-employed Social Worker and have been trying to work full-time and homeschool my son aged 10 throughout times when schools have been closed due to COVID-19 (his father also works full-time away from the home). Our mental health is suffering immensely and I cannot work effectively.

Allow golf courses to open for golfers playing on their own, Allow golf courses to open under restricted measures.
Single play only, allows exercise and practice, benefits mental health.
Reduced infection risk if single play adopted.

Ensure second Covid vaccine doses are delivered within 3 weeks of first doses., The Government must ensure that all Covid vaccinations that are reliant on double doses are delivered according to their manufacturer's specifications. For the Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine and the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine, that means delivering second doses within 3 weeks of first doses.

Give all Care Home residents their 2nd vaccine dose now, not in 3 months., Forgotten at the beginning of the pandemic & left struggling throughout. It is imperative that Care Home residents should not have to wait 3 months or more to get their second dose of vaccine. They have been through enough. This is vital to stop increased mental health problems as well as physical.

Prioritise all emergency / key workers for Covid 19 vaccinations., Allow emergency / key workers to be prioritised for vaccinations to allow them to carry out their duties in protecting the public and helping to create a safer UK. 

Allow any surplus vaccinations that are not used to be redeployed through available unallocated / unattended bookings.

Prioritise University Students for the COVID-19 vaccine, Prioritise University students (and lecturers) for the COVID-19 vaccine so that students can return to university and university accommodation safely. Most university students have had little to no face to face teaching this year but are still paying full tuition so should be a priority.

Lower tuition fees to a minimum £5,000 for University students during covid-19., Frankly, university students aren’t getting the education they were promised when they chose to go to university through such a tough year, as well as those in 2nd or 3rd years who have had their learning environment completely changed.
Change covid-19 second dose vaccination protocol from 12 weeks to 3 weeks, Please revert the covid-19 second dose to the advised schedule from Pfizer and WHO from 12 weeks apart to 3 weeks apart.

Reduce the gap between COVID-19 vaccinations to 4-6 weeks from 12 weeks., The current position of NHS England is to enforce a position of no second doses of COVID-19 vaccine until 12 weeks have passed from the first dose. There is no room for clinical discretion. The existing evidence supports a much shorter interval to give good efficacy at person level.

Allow Year 10/11 back into school!, Year 10/11 need to be allowed back into the classroom as we are the most vital year groups right now and we have such little time to turn it all around! It’s our futures at risk...

Help put postal workers on NHS priority list for vaccinations against COVID 19, During this time, Royal Mail has seen a lot of sickness, self-isolations and many casualties as a result of COVID-19. We would like the government to include postal workers on the list of priority groups for vaccines.
Vaccinate all staff in special needs school’s against COVID-19, Make it a priority to vaccinate all staff working in special needs schools.

Give ALL school staff the vaccine as a priority., All school staff should be offered the vaccine prior to schools reopening. This should be a priority.  Masks and opening windows is simply not enough.  School staff have the right to be protected as much as Doctors and Nurses if they are forced to work around those who transmit Covid 19.
Prioritise all essential workers for covid-19 vaccines, Prioritise key segments of the essential workforce putting themselves at risk day in day out for COVID-19 vaccines. These are unsung heroes.

Free prescriptions for all asthma sufferers, Asthma sufferers rely on inhalers to be able to live and yet they are having to pay for their prescriptions. Asthma is an ongoing health condition like epilepsy and diabetes, some of whom get their prescriptions free so why don’t asthmatics get them free?

Vaccinate British Citizens living in the UK  FIRST with the Covid 19 vaccine, To assure British citizens living in the UK that they will receive vaccinations FIRST and before others from other countries. To vaccinate the UK population FIRST and ENTIRELY before sending any vaccine abroad.

Don’t re-open schools until all staff have been vaccinated, Schools should not be re-opened until all school staff have been vaccinated. Without doing so, staff and their families could be put at risk from infection and further unnecessary and needless deaths. Let alone the mental health risks, which have already been stretched to the maximum.

Call on Government to publish numbers of people who die after a Covid-19 Vaccine, Open transparency and discussion of data related to the adverse effects of Covid-19 vaccinations, especially amoung the over 60's
Abolish devolved parliaments, We request a UK wide referendum that provides the option to abolish the devolved parliaments thus restoring full governmental control to Westminster.

Make mental health services an exemption to leave your home during lockdown, Counselling and other mental health services have been shut down or restricted during all 3 national lockdowns. By making attending mental health support services apart of the medical exemption, this will help save many peoples lives.

Start a national campaign to highlight the suicide rate in men under 50, The rate of suicide in men under the age of 50, which is the single largest cause of death, is a national tragedy. We need a national campaign to highlight this issue, to encourage the nation to take away the taboo that stops men talking and to educate men on mental health.

Once priority groups in the UK are vaccinated redirect Covid-19 vaccines abroad, Once priority groups, including the vulnerable and those aged over 50, are vaccinated, we must redirect our vaccines for export to low and middle-income countries, so they can vaccinate the vulnerable in their countries.

Allow priority vaccination for those working in close contact services, Key workers are not being offered priority vaccination against Covid 19. Many of us in the self employed and hair and beauty sector for example will be likely expected to return to work prior to receiving a vaccination, yet we are amongst those working in the closest proximity to the public.

Keep schools closed until May, Please don’t send students back until we know we have had the priority groups vaccinated such as the elderly, the extremely clinically vulnerable, and those with underlying health conditions.

Make Covid-19 antibody tests available for everyone, I want the Government to make Covid-19 antibody tests available for everyone. Currently these are only available to certain people who work in primary care, social care or education. These tests should be available alongside Covid-19 testing and the vaccine programme.

Get all police officers vaccinated first, Please get all police officers vaccinated first. There are loads of reasons for this push to get police officers vaccinated first because they can be considered as super spreaders of the virus
Open schools and universities, Vaccinate teachers

Introduce a 'Vaccination Passport' for international travel, A British 'Vaccine Passport' should be rolled out as solid proof of vaccination for international travel. This should contain manufacturer information, batch number and dates. It would need to be internationally recognised so as to allow international travel to those countries that demand proof.

Fund breast reductions on medical grounds for all women on the NHS, Breast reduction should be free for women who suffer in their everyday life due to large breasts. They can cause sever back/neck pain and difficulty breathing. This can lead to problems later on in life. It can affect every aspect of your day to day activities. Making you work harder to breathe.

Primary age children to be exempt from the rule of six., As a family of 5 we have been unable to see friends and family for a long time and fear that if the rule of six is used again and includes children it will be many more months before we can see our family. So many families are going through this.

Increase the priority of Clinically Vulnerable (CV) asthmatics for COVID vaccine, Either:

- Ensure asthmatics who are classed as moderate risk, and already receive the yearly flu jab, are included in Group 6 for the first phase of the rollout
- Alternatively commit to offering the vaccine to this group during the first group of the second phase.

Welsh Government to provide EXTRA financial support to small businesses NOW, The Welsh Government have promised Financial
Support for small businesses amid Lockdown number 3. The said funding/ financial support is still yet to be received and also nowhere near the level of support other parts of the country are receiving, We are receiving half of the amounts in England.

Increase awareness and investment for Peritoneal Cancer research., Peritoneal Cancer is one of the least known cancers and yet one of the most likely to result in death. This form of cancer is usually diagnosed at Stage 4. By investing in research, earlier diagnosis, better treatments and support can be found to treat one of the deadliest of cancers.

Allow ALL Asthmatics who take steroid inhalers to be included in Vaccine Group 6, We want all Asthmatics who use steroid inhalers and who are eligible for the flu jab each year to be included in COVID-19 Vaccination priority group 6. We are clinically vulnerable and have chronic lung conditions and we are at risk so should be prioritised over healthy adults.

To include remaining asthmatics in group 6 of the COVID vaccination programme., I want the government to review and reverse their decision on excluding all asthmatics (who are not in group 4) from group 6 of the COVID vaccination programme. All asthmatics need to be vaccinated in group 4 if severe and group 6 if mild to moderate.

Give those 16 - 65 clinically vulnerable from Covid-19, vaccine priority., Give all those who 16-65 who have not already been vaccinated, but receive a annual flu vaccine due to underlying health conditions, priority to the Covid-19 vaccine.

Have all asthma suffers moved to priority group 6, Asthma is a condition that affects the lungs and yet people with moderate or mild asthma are not considered a priority for the covid 19 vacine until the first nine groups have been injected
We ask the government to reconsider

Change the 'do not resuscitate' orders on patients with learning difficulties, Remove the 'do not resuscitate' instructions for the nhs that are in place for people with learning difficulties so that they are treated the same as everyone else.

Revise Covid vaccine priority groups to include "moderate" asthmatics., We ask Government to recognize that hospitalization/regular steroid tablet use is not the only indication of vulnerability to Covid-19 for asthma patients. Anyone on a steroid inhaler is clinically vulnerable to Covid-19 and therefore should be vaccinated as a priority.

Fund free HRT on the NHS for women experiencing the menopause, Women who go through the menopause should not to have to pay for Hormone replacement therapy (HRT) medication. I was shocked as I thought this would have been free for all women. The Government needs to make change so HRT is free!

Reprioritise Asthma Sufferers for COVID Vaccines, I urge the UK Government to reconsider the priority for Asthma Sufferers to receive a Covid Vaccine to prevent unnecessary deaths or long term side effects such as “long COVID” for a large proportion of the population.

Prohibit employers from requiring employees to have a Covid-19 vaccine, Make it unlawful for employers to mandate vaccination. Eg “no jab no job policies” there are reports some companies are considering.

Increase vaccination priority for moderate risk (clinically vulnerable) people, I'm calling for people who are judged at moderate risk (clinically vulnerable) from Covid-19 to be given increased priority in the Covid-19 vaccination programme.

They either need to be included in Group 6 or included in the very first group of phase 2.

Pass a law for no referendums on the constitution for at least 30 years, Put a UK wide Law in place to have in statute that no referendums on the constitution can take place for at least 30 years - so until 2051.
Classify Covid-19 as an Occupational Disease, The Government should classify Covid-19 as an occupational disease when workplace exposure occurred.

Do not allow mandatory vaccines as a condition of employment, Companies are starting to talk about implementing no jab no job policies whereby they can insist that new staff must have received the COVID-19 vaccine as a condition of their employment. This should not be allowed as it is discriminatory.

Outlaw discrimination against those who do not get a Covid-19 vaccination, The individual must remain sovereign over their own body, discrimination against those who cannot or will not be vaccinated against COVID is incompatible with a free democracy. The Government must take firm action to prevent 'vaccination passports' and discriminatory 'no jab, no job' policies.

Review how babies with Tongue Tie are diagnosed and treated, Tongue-tie is where the skin joining a baby's tongue to the bottom of their mouth is shorter than usual. The condition can cause difficulties for the infant, especially when feeding.

Provide free basic wifi to all homes in England., I believe basic wifi should be free to all. My example is a vulnerable adult during covid restrictions not being able request medication from GP as he was told to do it online and he did not have access to this and also did not know how to use if he had got access.

Ensure Scots living in the UK have a vote in any future independence referendum, If there's a Scottish independence referendum, Scots-born citizens in any other part of the UK should be allowed a vote.
Open schools on the 8th of March., Open schools to all pupils on the 8th of March to minimise the amount of missed education and to prioritise the mental wellbeing of this generation.

Create a priority group for Key Workers in the COVID-19 Vaccination Programme, After the remaining priority groups have been vaccinated, make sure that all key workers are vaccinated before distributing to the rest of the adult population.

A law for NO descrimination against anyone without a vaccine or vaccine passport, Need a law passed that anyone who refuses and doesn't have a vaccine is not descriminated against, in the place of work, shops or any other public place.

Offer Group B streptococcus (GBS) test to all pregnant women, My son was born in 2020 and within 24 hours rapidly deteriorated and was taken into hospital again. After further testing he was put on antibiotics to treat for sepsis due to group B strep and after a lumbar puncture found he had viral meningitis on the brain all due to this bacterial infection.

Change the law for fathers rights to see their children., Stop mothers from using children as a weapon to hurt the fathers. Children need both parents in their lives, providing neither parents are abuive

Include teachers in priority group for the vaccine before schools return, Healthcare and social care workers are being prioritised to receive the vaccine, so why not teachers? Teachers are being expected to return to schools on 8th March with little to no PPE and no guarantee that they will receive the vaccine before others their age who are working from home.

Do not make it mandatory to wear a mask in the classroom, To ensure that children and teachers can thrive in the school environment, we ask the government to not make it mandatory for pupils and staff to have to wear a face mask in classrooms.

Pupils and staff should retain the right to chose for themselves whether wearing a face mask is necessary.

Do not make it mandatory to wear a mask in the classroom., To ensure that children and teachers can thrive in the school environment, we ask the government to not make it mandatory for pupils and staff to have to wear a face mask in classrooms. Pupils and staff should be given the right to chose for themselves whether wearing a face mask is necessary.
Prioritise blind and partially sighted for Covid-19 vaccination, We want the government to include blind and partially sighted people in the priority list.

Do not impose "DO NOT ATTEMPT TO RESUSCITATE" ORDERS ON PEOPLE WITH DISABILITIES, I have seen reports that due to the Covid Pandemic, people with learning difficulties and people with disabilities will be labelled with DNR's if they enter hospital. This is a blatant disregard for peoples human rights to live!

Do not reopen of schools on 8th March, We would like the government to stagger the start of term until the R rate has been lowered, teachers are vaccinated and it is proven to be safe to go outside, after being told to ‘Stay at Home’ for months. Many of us are traumatised by personal bereavement and do not feel safe returning to school.

Stop large public events being held until everyone is offered a COVID-19 vaccine, We would urge the government to reconsider allowing large public events such as shows, carnivals, pop concerts to take place until the entire nation has been offered a vaccine against COVID-19.

Add funeral mourners to the travel exemption list for testing on days 2 and 8., I would like the Government to add funeral mourners of close family members to the exemption list for getting a costly £210pp travel testing package. For two persons travelling abroad, the cost of required Covid testing alone is over £700. Elite sportspeople are exempted, why not funeral mourners?
Get blood sugar meters and test strips issued on prescription, Allow people who have Type 2 diabetes to have prescriptions for blood sugar testing meters, lancets and test strips.

Do not require health and social care workers to take covid-19 vaccination, We, the people, demand that health and social care workers are given the right to exercise free will in relation to any medical procedure and so to be able to refuse to take the covid 19 vaccination without fear of facing discrimination at work or in wider society.

Speed up the License medication process through NICE to help HD sufferers, To try and speed up the process of Licensing medication that are near the end of the trial stages, that have shown success, through NICE to help sufferers of this neuro-degenerative disease.

Introduce Covid-19 testing in primary schools in England for all staff & pupils., The Government must urgently introduce rapid tests in primary schools to pick up infections ASAP to help prevent entire year bubbles being sent home to isolate because one person has tested positive. Testing has been introduced in secondary schools and colleges already to help keep schools open.

Create council tax exemptions and railway discounts for part-time students, Currently only full-time students can benefit from council tax exemptions and there is not a railcard for part-time students, excluding many part-time students who face the same costs (over a longer time period) and mature students from returning to education. This is not fair.

Add "vaccine status" to Equalities Act as a new protected characteristic., Add "vaccine status" to Equalities Act as a new protected characteristic, thus making it illegal to discriminate on grounds of an individual's vaccine status.

Fund annual cancer reviews for anyone with a family history of cancer, A major risk factor for cancer is a family history. My mum, Laura (36) lost her mum and gran to cancer at a young age. She had seen the GP numerous times with pain but was never taken seriously. The pain was actually due to a cancerous tumour pressing on a nerve and now, she’s battling cancer.

Do not rollout Covid-19 vaccine certificates., We want the Government to commit to not rolling out any e-vaccination status/immunity certificate to the British public. Such certificates could be used to restrict the rights of people who have refused a Covid-19 vaccine, which would be unacceptable & against our human rights.
Reduce the Tax exemption age for classic cars to 30 years., I would like the Government to reduce the tax exemption age for classic cars, from 40 years to 30 years.

Refuse UK entry to non-UK residents who do not have a COVID-19 vaccine passport., Refuse entry to non-UK residents without proof of COVID-19 vaccination.
UK residents who choose not to be vaccinated should undergo quarantine and testing when returning from abroad.

Confirm a timeline to pass the ban on LGBT+ Conversion Therapy into law, The Government must confirm a timeline as to when the ban on LGBT+ conversion therapy will be passed as legislation and be made illegal under the law. If Government continues to drag further, it will affect LGBT+ people who as of now are receiving harmful and unethical treatments and practices.

Generically Rebrand the Turing Scheme, Alan Turing, helped to crack the Enigma codes and invent modern computer science.

He was also Gay, at 40 he accepted Chemical Castration for his "crime"

In 1954 he died from cyanide poisoning.

He was treated appallingly, so a petition to posthumously pardon him  was welcome.
